##### Project general facts

Bond Living by Pearlshire Developments is a refined residential project thoughtfully designed for modern, everyday living, offering a boutique collection of studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments. The development blends elegant architecture with smart layouts, generous natural light, and calming interiors that feel both intuitive and welcoming. With its limited number of residences, Bond Living creates a private, well-balanced environment that reflects Pearlshire’s hospitality-driven approach to home design.

The amenities are carefully curated to enhance comfort, wellness, and leisure, delivering a resort-inspired lifestyle within the building. Residents can enjoy a stunning rooftop infinity pool, yoga and meditation deck, jogging track, outdoor cinema, barbecue areas, and relaxing lounge spaces with open views. Every shared space is designed to encourage relaxation, social connection, and a sense of effortless daily luxury.

Interiors at Bond Living are finished to a high standard, combining warmth, functionality, and contemporary style. Apartments feature smart home-ready automation, European flooring, spa-inspired bathrooms with modern vanities, and fully integrated kitchens fitted with high-spec appliances. Seamless glass sliding doors open onto spacious balconies, while quality materials and refined finishes create homes that feel elegant, comfortable, and timeless. 

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) is a sprawling and diverse community located in Dubai, offering a multitude of entertainment, leisure, and residential opportunities. This vibrant community is renowned for its wide range of attractions and experiences, making it a unique destination that caters to residents and visitors of all ages.

At the heart of Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) is its extensive array of world-class entertainment and leisure destinations. The community is home to numerous theme parks, including Dubai Parks and Resorts, which features Legoland, Motiongate, Bollywood Parks, and the immersive waterpark experience of Legoland Water Park. These attractions provide endless fun and entertainment for families, creating memorable experiences for both children and adults alike.

Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) also boasts a variety of sporting facilities and outdoor spaces, catering to the needs of sports enthusiasts and those seeking an active lifestyle. The community is home to renowned golf courses, tennis courts, cycling tracks, and expansive parks, providing opportunities for outdoor activities and leisurely pursuits.
